description: Lybra verb contracts — single source of truth for gate tool names, parameter shapes, two-phase (dry_run → confirm) semantics, stage contracts, preconditions, and response field derivation. CLI, MCP, manual, and response hints are ALL projections of this file. No handwritten second source.
source_of_truth: This file is the ONLY place a connector may learn a verb name, parameter shape, stage contract, or response field derivation. CLI subcommands, MCP response fields, and advisor manual verb references are generated from this file. No handwritten per-verb wrappers anywhere.

aipos_c1.purpose: AIPOS-C1: verbs.schema as the single truth for the verb surface. CLI/MCP/manual/response-hints are four projections.

projections.cli: tools/aipos_cli/aipos_cli.py — queue subcommands derived from verbs with surface=cli or phase declarations
projections.mcp_response: tools/mcp_server/tools.py — owner_confirmation_required and client_hint derived from stage_contract.self_confirm_allowed
projections.manual: tools/generate_advisor_commands.py — COMMANDS verb reference section generated from this schema
projections.assertion: tools/test_aipos_c1_surface_consistency.py — validates all projections match this schema

two_phase_protocol.description: Mutation verbs follow dry_run → confirm two-phase pattern. dry_run previews without side effects and (for claim/return) returns a dry_run_token; confirm executes.

dry_run.returns: Operation plan, validation results, and (for claim/return) dry_run_token for confirmation

confirm.requires: claim/return: valid dry_run_token from the dry_run phase. close: replays task_id + actor + closure_evidence (no dry_run_token).

project_json_writers.description: AIPOS-F125: 写 project.json 的本地 CLI 命令(`lybra project <命令>`)同一两阶段语义的唯一声明(AIPOS-F123 set-paths 首用, 本卡推广到 set-repo / set-repos / set-workstation)。缺省 = 预演: 打印将写的 project.json unified diff 与声明校验结果, 零写入(校验不过 = 预演即报错, 非零退出); --confirm 才写。预演/写入同一实现 = workspace_config.update_project_json(dry_run; 写前以读取口预检将写入的内容), CLI 旗标注册与输出渲染同一包装 aipos_cli._project_json_two_phase_*(四命令共用, 禁各写一份)。经 ssh 远程调用同语义(预演零写入)。日后新增写 project.json 的命令登记于 commands 即得同一两阶段。

flag_help.dry_run: Preview the project.json diff and validation without writing (default)

outcome_labels.preview: 预览(未写; 加 --confirm 写入)

project_json_writers.output_scope: 只涉 project.json(路径 + diff + 校验结果); 禁打印凭据或 connection.json 内容。set-repo 门路径(connection.json 声明 mcp.rpc_url)的预演亦在本机经同一实现算 diff, 不取凭据、不调门动词; --confirm 才经门动词 lybra_project_set_repo_dry_run → _confirm 写入。

target_resolution.description: AIPOS-F127 件①(chris 第 2 步预演发现: set-paths 不写项目名时落到 home 级活动项目 lybra): project 族写命令(commands 全部 + freeze-legacy + dispatch-mode set)目标项目解析的唯一实现 = workspace_config.resolve_project_write_target。序: 显式项目名 > --workspace-root(dispatch-mode 为 --project-root)/当前目录向上首个已建治理根(project.json + 声明的队列根)声明的 project.json#project > 拒。禁回落 home 级活动项目(LYBRA_ACTIVE_PROJECT / ~/.lybra/config.json active_project / 单项目回落)。显式项目名与所在治理根声明不一致(或 home 根下同名项目不是所在治理根)= 拒并列出两者。预演/写入输出首行 = target_line(四个两阶段命令与 set-meta 同一包装 aipos_cli._project_json_two_phase_emit)。

sources.explicit_matches_root: 显式项目名(与所在治理根声明一致)

reject_codes.PROJECT_TARGET_UNRESOLVED: 未给项目名, 且 --workspace-root 未给 / 当前目录不在任何已建治理根内(向上无 project.json + 队列根), 或该治理根未声明 project.json#project; 不回落 home 级活动项目。出口: 写项目名, 或在目标项目治理根下运行, 或传 --workspace-root <治理根>
reject_codes.PROJECT_TARGET_CONFLICT: 显式项目名与所在治理根声明的项目不一致(两者已列出)。出口: 改写正确的项目名, 或到目标项目治理根下运行(可省项目名)

meta.description: AIPOS-F127 件③: `lybra project set-meta [项目] [--phase <文本>] [--note <文本>] [--dry-run|--confirm]` 写 project.json 顶层说明键(接入方此前只能手改或留旧文)。唯一实现 workspace_config.set_project_meta: 经 update_project_json 唯一写路径(锁 + 预演 diff + 写后复核); 每个键须在 config.schema configuration_sources.project_json.schema 已声明(未声明 = 拒 META_KEY_UNDECLARED, 零写入; 本表只登记 CLI 旗标 → project.json 键, 不声明键的形), 值按该声明 type/enum 校验(非空单行串)。其余键原样保留。

reject_codes.META_KEY_UNDECLARED: 该键未在 config.schema configuration_sources.project_json.schema 声明(产品不写未声明的 project.json 键)。出口: 先在该处声明此键(type string, required false, 缺省 = 不写即行为不变)
reject_codes.META_VALUE_INVALID: 值不合声明(须为非空单行串; enum 键须在值域)

warn_behavior.description: WARN behavior contract - consistent across all verbs
rules: WARN is non-blocking - operation proceeds with warnings
WARN never consumes tokens - dry_run_token remains valid
WARN messages are recorded but do not prevent confirmation
Executor can proceed through WARN to completion

response_field_derivation.description: Rules for deriving MCP response fields from stage_contract. Single source — no handwritten conditionals in tools.py.

rules.owner_confirmation_required: true if stage_contract.self_confirm_allowed is empty (no one can self-confirm); false otherwise
rules.client_hint: Generated from stage_contract.self_confirm_allowed: if non-empty, hint says 'self-confirm allowed with OWNER_CONFIRMED literal'; if empty, hint says 'owner must confirm via owner scope'

scope_contract.description: AIPOS-F101 件②: 门工具(tools/mcp_server/tools.py TOOL_HANDLERS 全集)的工具名与 scope 唯一声明处 = 本文件 verbs[<工具名>]。门工具执法(调用时)、可见性(tools/list)、verb_contract 注册表一律读此声明, 代码不另写 scope 常量/映射(禁第二来源); 未声明的门工具 = SchemaLoadError(fail-closed)。参数形状仍以 tools.py 描述符 inputSchema 为准(本次只收工具名/scope/可见性)。

fields.required_scope: 调用时必须持有的操作 scope; null = 无操作 scope(只读, 或 Owner 门在参数 owner_authorization_ref / bearer 角色上)
fields.also_requires_scope: 在 required_scope 之外另需的 scope(如 owner_confirm: 执行体 token 不可自确认)
fields.conditional_scope: {scope, when}: 仅当 when 所述条件成立时另需的 scope
fields.scope_waiver: {param, equals, reason}: 入参 param 去空白后等于 equals 时不索 required_scope(驱动方一阶段, 信封即授权)
fields.visibility: tools/list 可见性: always = 恒可见; scope = 持 required_scope 才可见; hidden = 不列出(只经产品 CLI 薄壳按名调用)

lane_view.description: AIPOS-F133 件②(CONVERGENCE §3c-3/5、§3d-7): 按 lane(子项目 = 卡解析后的产品仓)看进度的参数唯一声明。四个查看命令(lybra next 项目扫描 / lybra brief / lybra loop status / lybra needs-owner)同一 --lane 参数、同一过滤函数; 不带 --lane 时 brief 与 needs-owner 按 lane 分组输出。lane 键唯一派生 = machine_zone.card_lane_key(解析走 workspace_config.resolve_card_repo, 返回 project.json repos.items 仓名; 无仓清单的单仓项目 = code_repo 路径)。卡遍历只走 task_loader.iter_queue_task_paths, loop status 经 task_loader.find_task_card 反查卡面。lane 解析不了的卡 = unresolved_lane 标签: 不带 --lane 时照列(分组末尾, 带原因); AIPOS-F141 件②: 带 --lane 时只列 lane ∈ 所给集合的卡, lane 解析不了的卡不混入所选 lane, 在输出末尾单独一组「未归 lane N 张」(计数 + 卡号, 提示补 lane.repo 或冻结)。AIPOS-F141 件①: 四命令共用唯一「可见卡」入口 machine_zone.visible_cards(冻结在先: 是否冻结只调 F122 唯一判定 legacy_baseline.frozen_tasks, 缺省不列, 汇总行注明冻结 N 张未列, --include-frozen 照列并标 frozen; 冻结清单读不出 = 汇总行点名错误, 不隐藏任何卡; 然后 lane 过滤只经 filter_rows_by_lane)。loop status 给 --task-id = 显式点名该卡, 照列(冻结则标 frozen)。
lane_view.help: AIPOS-F133/F139: 只看该 lane(project.json repos.items 仓名或其绝对路径; 无仓清单的单仓项目 = code_repo 路径); 可重复给出仓集合(--lane a --lane b = 子项目跨仓一并看, 共用仓可同时出现在多个顾问的集合里); 集合内任一仓未声明即拒; 给出时 lane 解析不了的卡不混入, 末尾单独计数「未归 lane N 张」(AIPOS-F141)
lane_view.single_implementation: tools/aipos_cli/machine_zone.visible_cards(四命令唯一可见卡入口, AIPOS-F141) / render_visible_summary / card_lane_key / lane_of_card / resolve_lane_filter / filter_rows_by_lane / group_rows_by_lane / lane_filter_label

visible_cards.description: AIPOS-F141: 四个查看命令共用的「可见卡」口径(唯一实现 machine_zone.visible_cards; 汇总行唯一渲染 render_visible_summary)。冻结卡缺省不列(判定 = legacy_baseline.frozen_tasks), include_frozen_flag 显式列出(只读, 行标 frozen_marker); 给定 --lane 时 lane 解析不了的卡单独成「未归 lane」组。文字模板占位: frozen_summary {count} {flag}; frozen_error_summary {error}; unresolved_summary {count} {task_ids} {lane}。--json 输出附 frozen_hidden(卡号) / unresolved_lane([{task_id, lane_error}]) / frozen_error(next --json 仍为行列表, 冻结行带 frozen: true)。
visible_cards.include_frozen_help: AIPOS-F141: 也列出存量冻结卡(只读, 标 [frozen]); 缺省不列, 汇总行给冻结张数
visible_cards.frozen_summary: 冻结 {count} 张未列(存量冻结卡 = 历史, 判定 legacy_baseline; {flag} 可列出)
visible_cards.frozen_error_summary: 存量冻结清单读不出(冻结不生效, 未隐藏任何卡): {error}
visible_cards.unresolved_summary: 未归 lane {count} 张(lane 不可解析, 不混入 lane {lane}): {task_ids} —— 补卡面 lane.repo(project.json repos.items 仓名)或冻结

lane_view.repo_set: AIPOS-F139(Owner 10-09 方案 A): --lane 与信封 task_selector_lane_repo 都是仓集合, 写法 = 参数可重复(`--lane a --lane b` / `lybra envelope mint --lane-repo a --lane-repo b`), 不按逗号拆分(仓指称可为绝对路径, 逗号无转义歧义; 与既有 --policy-id / --launch-harness 可重复同一惯例)。集合的序列化与解析唯一实现 = workspace_config.repo_name_set(去空去重保序; 单个字符串 = 单元素集合, 存量单值信封据此读、文件不改写); 过滤仍只在 filter_rows_by_lane(行 lane ∈ 集合; AIPOS-F141: 未解析 lane 不混入, 单独计数), 信封判定仍只在 autonomy_policy.match_claim_envelope。JSON 输出 lane_filter = 规范 lane 键列表; 分组输出不变。同仓合入由 F135 自动排队。
lane_view.next_card: lybra next 项目扫描首位给「下一张可推进卡」= pending 且可推导(依赖满足, 判据唯一实现 task_complexity.dependencies_satisfied)的卡中优先级最高者(enums.schema priority 值序, 后者高; 同级按 task_id); 无则写明原因。结案后取下一张的唯一出口

performance.description: AIPOS-F142 件③: 四视图(loop status / next 项目扫描 / needs-owner / brief)性能阈值与回归夹具规模的唯一声明(夹具 tests/test_aipos_f142_view_speed_quiet_trace.py 读本段造临时治理根并测时)。阈值是产品目标(秒); 夹具断言用 阈值 × ci_slack_factor(沙箱/并发 CI 宽裕), 原始耗时与阈值一并打印。实现约束: 一次视图调用全程一个只读作用域(task_loader.task_card_lookup_scope, 可重入): 队列索引一趟、冻结清单重放一次、信封已放行计数一趟(lookup_scope_memo); --task-id 只读该卡运行记录, 已结束运行不探活; 结案取下一张只扫可当选状态(next_resolver.NEXT_CARD_STATES)。

envelope_trace.description: AIPOS-F142 件②: 门侧信封判定诊断行([ENVELOPE_TRACE], autonomy_policy.trace_envelope 逐谓词留痕, 走 stderr)的输出开关唯一声明。开关只在发射处一处判定(autonomy_policy.envelope_trace_enabled), 所有调用方受同一开关约束: CLI(lybra 入口 aipos_cli.main → cli_envelope_trace)缺省关, --verbose(挂在 verbose_commands 所列命令, 唯一挂载口 autonomy_policy.attach_verbose_flags)或调试环境变量 debug_env 开; in-process 嵌套调用(loop 驱动器执行派生命令)沿用外层决定; 不经 CLI 入口的进程(门 MCP 服务, journald 留痕 AIPOS-PRERELEASE-1)取 non_cli_default_enabled。只开关调试轨迹输出, 信封判定逻辑与结果不变; 门拒时的拒因与原因链由各命令照常输出。
envelope_trace.verbose_help: AIPOS-F142 件②: 另输出门侧信封判定诊断行([ENVELOPE_TRACE], stderr); 缺省不打印(只收调试轨迹, 门拒的拒因与原因链照常输出)

lybra_queue_list.description: Read the task queue (executor's only read surface).

lybra_distribution_manifest.description: AIPOS-C4B: Return the distribution manifest for the caller's role (file list + sha256 hashes + source commit per distributable). Worker-side lybra sync compares local _distributed against this and pulls only diffs. Passive, read-only, role-scoped.

lybra_distribution_fetch.description: AIPOS-C4B: Return base64 file content for requested distribution files (by distribution_id + paths). Paths validated against role manifest; traversal/out-of-manifest paths rejected. Worker-initiated pull, zero push.

paths.description: File paths relative to the distribution source

lybra_task_preview.description: Read-only task session preview by task_id or path. include_body=true returns the card body markdown (requires queue_claim scope).

include_body.description: Include card body markdown (requires queue_claim scope)

lybra_return_content.description: Read-only: return RETURN.md body for a returned task (auditor cross-machine evidence). Requires queue_claim scope.

lybra_queue_claim_dry_run.description: Claim a pending task (preview; PreAuthorized may release in one phase).

stage_contract.self_confirm_mechanism: AIPOS-328: executor passes owner_confirmation_token='OWNER_CONFIRMED' literal (not a secret, not owner scope)
stage_contract.client_hint_template: AIPOS-328: executor自行confirm。使用 lybra_queue_claim_confirm 带上 dry_run_token 与 owner_confirmation_token='OWNER_CONFIRMED'(字面常量,非秘密)。Owner不需参与此步骤。
stage_contract.client_timeout_note: AIPOS-F90 件①(缺陷③): 认领在门内同步建卡工作树(git worktree add)+ 落记录, 客户端等待上限须覆盖门处理时长(原 GateClient 写死 10s 致假失败); 未声明 client_timeout_ms 的动词用 config.schema timeouts.gate_mcp_request_ms。读取口 two_phase_shell_factory.client_timeout_seconds。

timeout_readback.rule: AIPOS-F90 件①(缺陷③): 等门应答超时不得直接报失败——经门只读动词回读该卡: queue_state==landed_queue_state 且 metadata.<claimer_field>==请求的 <claimer_arg> = 门侧已落(幂等: 已由本实例认领 = 成功, 不重复提交); 否则未落/未知 = 出声失败带出口(lybra next 重推导核实)。dry_run 与 confirm 两阶段同读此判据(two_phase_shell_factory.readback_after_timeout 唯一实现)。

task_id.description: Task to claim (selector: task_id XOR task_path)

lybra_queue_claim_confirm.description: Confirm a claim dry-run (AIPOS-328: self-confirm via owner_confirmation_token literal).

lybra_queue_adopt_dry_run.description: AIPOS-F123 件①: 收编人肉期在途卡(claimed 目录、无门生 claim 记录、未冻结)——门补铸 claim 记录(adopted_from=legacy_manual, 绑定既有分支与 tip)、写卡面运行时字段、按 card_worktree_location 建卡工作树。claim 动词族(transitions nodes.N1.adoption): 驱动方 token + autonomy_mode=PreAuthorized + 覆盖驱动方与本卡的信封 = 一段式落记录(与 claim 同一 matcher); preview_only=true = 只预览零写入(含信封判定)。无 Supervised 逐单路径。

stage_contract.one_stage: autonomy_mode=PreAuthorized 且信封匹配 → 门在本动词一跳内落记录(preauthorized_release=true); 不匹配 = BLOCK + envelope_guards 出口(CLI exit 5); preview_only=true 恒不写
stage_contract.client_timeout_note: 收编在门内同步建卡工作树(git worktree add)+ 落记录, 与 claim 同等待上限

branch.description: 卡 lane.repo 解析仓内的既有分支(本地或远端跟踪分支名)

actor.description: 提交收编的驱动方实例(记 adopted_by); claim 记录 actor = 卡面 agent_instance/assigned_to

autonomy_mode.description: 写入只认 PreAuthorized(一段式信封); preview_only 时可缺省

owner_policy_ref.description: 覆盖驱动方与本卡的信封 policy_id(project.json paths.policies_root)

preview_only.description: true = 只预览(CLI --dry-run), 零写入

workspace_root.description: 治理根(AIPOS-F42 解析序同 claim)

scope_waiver.reason: AIPOS-F78B 件③ 驱动方一阶段: Owner 签的信封即授权, 不索本 scope; 无信封匹配 = 门拒(envelope_guards), 永不静默回落 Supervised

stage_contract.client_hint_template: AIPOS-328: executor自行confirm。使用 lybra_queue_return_confirm 带上 dry_run_token 与 owner_confirmation_token='OWNER_CONFIRMED'(字面常量,非秘密)。Owner不需参与此步骤。

autonomy_mode.description: Supervised(执行体两阶段) | PreAuthorized(AIPOS-F78B 件③: 驱动方 token + owner_autonomy_policy 信封一阶段落记录, 不索 owner_confirm)

return_body.description: RETURN.md body text (gate writes it to the declared Return location <project.json paths.return_root>/<ID>/ on confirm)

model.description: AIPOS-F90 件②: 产品按卡面 harness 的会话记录定位器(card.schema intent_face.harness.session_record_locators)取的运行时模型; 取不到 = 定位器声明的 missing_value(「未声明会话记录」), 不采信自报

model_source.description: AIPOS-F90 件②: 运行时模型出处(<harness>:<会话记录文件名>), 取不到 = missing_value

model_mismatch.description: AIPOS-F90 件②: 自报(model_self_reported)与运行时模型不一致 = true(自报只作对照, 记录标出)

lybra_queue_return_confirm.description: Confirm a return dry-run (AIPOS-328: executor self-confirm via owner_confirmation_token).

lybra_queue_close_dry_run.description: Close a task (preview). closure_evidence is an OBJECT, not a flat string.

scope_waiver.reason: AIPOS-F78B 件③ 驱动方一阶段: Owner 签的信封即授权, 不索本 scope; 无信封匹配 = 门拒(envelope_guards), 永不静默回落 Supervised

stage_contract.confirm_mechanism: replay_args: confirm replays task_id + actor + closure_evidence (no dry_run_token)
stage_contract.self_confirm_mechanism: Executor with queue_close scope can close directly; no owner_confirmation_token needed
stage_contract.client_hint_template: Executor可直接close(queue_close scope)。使用 lybra queue close --task-id <ID> --actor <ACTOR> --closure-evidence '<JSON>'。无需owner确认。

closure_evidence.description: At least one of: finalize_commit_hash, finalize_return_ref, owner_verification_ref.

autonomy_mode.description: AIPOS-F78B 件③: PreAuthorized = 驱动方 token 经 owner_autonomy_policy 信封一阶段落记录(信封 agent_or_role 覆盖驱动方, verb ∈ lybra_loop.envelope.allowed_verbs); 缺省 Supervised(存量: queue_close scope 直落)

owner_policy_ref.description: PreAuthorized 时必填: 覆盖驱动方的信封 policy_id

lybra_queue_close_confirm.description: Confirm close. Replays task_id + actor + closure_evidence (NO dry_run_token — close confirm takes the full args again).

closure_evidence.description: At least one of: finalize_commit_hash, finalize_return_ref, owner_verification_ref.

autonomy_mode.description: AIPOS-F78B 件③: PreAuthorized = 驱动方 token 经 owner_autonomy_policy 信封一阶段落记录(信封 agent_or_role 覆盖驱动方, verb ∈ lybra_loop.envelope.allowed_verbs); 缺省 Supervised(存量: queue_close scope 直落)

owner_policy_ref.description: PreAuthorized 时必填: 覆盖驱动方的信封 policy_id

lybra_task_progress.description: Report task progress (single-phase). NOTE: field is event_type, NOT status.

lybra_mark_concluded.description: Mark a task as concluded (bypass path for report-style audits). AIPOS-C1: precondition = target card must NOT have a formal verdict; if it does, refuse and point to lybra_queue_close.

preconditions.description: Target card must NOT have a formal audit verdict (PASS/PASS_WITH_NOTES/FAIL/BLOCK). If a formal verdict exists, the card must be closed via lybra_queue_close, not mark-concluded.
preconditions.recovery: 已有门生裁决 → 改用 lybra queue close 结案(非 mark-concluded);下一步=走 close 动词
preconditions.redirect_hint: Task {task_id} has a formal verdict ({verdict}). Use 'lybra queue close' instead of mark-concluded.

lybra_enroll_code_dry_run.description: AIPOS-F23: advisor-driven enrollment code issuance (preview). Issues a SELF-CONTAINED code embedding gate_url/governance_root/transport credential (base64). Owner-gated via owner_authorization_ref. F24A: CLI `lybra roles enroll-code` is a THIN SHELL over this verb (in-server issuance is the single path; unknown parameters are rejected fail-closed).

stage_contract.client_hint_template: AIPOS-328: 顾问自行confirm。使用 lybra_enroll_code_confirm 带上 dry_run_token 与 owner_confirmation_token='OWNER_CONFIRMED'(字面常量,非秘密)。confirm 输出 paste_text = 交给接收方执行的产品兑换命令(AIPOS-F93 件②: 唯一渲染 onboarding.render_enroll_command, 门与 CLI 共用)。

role.description: Role to bind (e.g., executor, auditor, or registered custom role)

instance.description: Optional instance name to bind (e.g., exec.lybra.mac1); omit for any instance

ttl.description: Code time-to-live in seconds (default 86400 = 24h; also bounds the embedded transport credential)

gate_url.description: Externally reachable gate URL to embed (e.g., http://host:7118); defaults to connection.json mcp.rpc_url if non-loopback, else http://127.0.0.1:7118

governance_root.description: Governance workspace root to embed in the code (F24A): bare registered project name or absolute path <home>/<project>; validated against the project registry (queue root per project.json paths.queue_root + project.json), unknown/unregistered roots are rejected fail-closed. Defaults to the issuing gate's serving workspace root (same root as exchange/land).

owner_authorization_ref.description: Reference to owner authorization for this enrollment (owner-gated)

reason.description: Reason for generating this enrollment code

lybra_enroll_code_confirm.description: AIPOS-F23: confirm enrollment code issuance. Mints the self-contained code and returns paste_text = the product enroll command the recipient runs (AIPOS-F93: single render onboarding.render_enroll_command, shared by gate and CLI)

lybra_roles_enroll_exchange.description: AIPOS-362/F23: exchange an enrollment code (plain or self-contained) for a capability token. PUBLIC at operation level — the code itself is the authentication (transport auth = embedded transport credential for self-contained codes). Atomic landing (F23): first exchange opens a grace window (code retryable for the SAME token until landed or grace expiry); client calls lybra_roles_enroll_land after writing workstation config.

code.description: Enrollment code (self-contained LYBRAENROLL1.<base64> or plain code)

lybra_roles_enroll_land.description: AIPOS-F23: confirm the workstation landed its config (marks the enrollment landed; closes the grace window; after this the code is fully consumed). PUBLIC at operation level — called with the same code (code itself is the auth).

code.description: Enrollment code (self-contained or plain) that was exchanged

landed_detail.description: Optional landing evidence note (e.g. workstation root + files written)

lybra_roles_enroll_revoke.description: AIPOS-362: revoke an enrollment code. Idempotent. Owner-gated: requires owner_authorization_ref.

owner_authorization_ref.description: Reference to owner authorization for this revocation

lybra_project_new_dry_run.description: AIPOS-F24: scaffold a fresh project under the governance home (preview). Creates queue structure, project.json, decision_log stub, and connection.json skeleton with mcp.rpc_url from gate config. Owner-gated via owner_authorization_ref. CLI薄壳模式: lybra project new 是本动词的薄壳,唯一实现在门内(调用 workspace_config.scaffold_project)。

stage_contract.client_hint_template: 项目顾问自行confirm。使用 lybra_project_new_confirm 带上 dry_run_token 与 owner_confirmation_token='OWNER_CONFIRMED'。

code_repo.description: Optional absolute path to the project's code repo

home_root.description: Governance home root; defaults to gate's serving home

lybra_project_set_repo_dry_run.description: AIPOS-F24: set/update a project's code_repo mapping (preview). Owner-gated. CLI薄壳: lybra project set-repo 是本动词的薄壳。

code_repo.description: Absolute path to the code repo

lybra_audit_dispatch_dry_run.description: Dispatch an audit (preview). AIPOS-C1: idempotent — if audit card already exists, supplements dispatch record instead of blocking.

lybra_audit_verdict_dry_run.description: Submit audit verdict (preview). AIPOS-F35: auditor submits verdict after writing audit report.

stage_contract.client_hint_template: AIPOS-328: auditor自行confirm。使用 lybra_audit_verdict_confirm 带上 dry_run_token 与 owner_confirmation_token='OWNER_CONFIRMED'(字面常量,非秘密)。Owner不需参与此步骤。

model.description: AIPOS-F90 件②: 产品按卡面 harness 的会话记录定位器(card.schema intent_face.harness.session_record_locators)取的运行时模型; 取不到 = 定位器声明的 missing_value(「未声明会话记录」), 不采信自报

model_source.description: AIPOS-F90 件②: 运行时模型出处(<harness>:<会话记录文件名>), 取不到 = missing_value

model_mismatch.description: AIPOS-F90 件②: 自报(model_self_reported)与运行时模型不一致 = true(自报只作对照, 记录标出)

artifact_subject.description: AIPOS-F70: 裁决绑定的精确产物(commit SHA/tree hash). task_mode=code 的被审卡必须提供此参数,否则 BLOCK (fail-closed).

repository.description: 仓库标识(如 lybra, 项目无关设计)

commit_sha.description: 被审 commit 的完整 SHA (40字符)

tree_hash.description: 被审 commit 的 tree hash (40字符, Git tree object SHA)

package_digest.description: 部署类卡的包摘要(可选, 如 sha256:...)

autonomy_mode.description: Supervised (AIPOS-F22B) | PreAuthorized(AIPOS-F78B 件③: 驱动方 token + owner_autonomy_policy 信封一阶段落记录, 不索 owner_confirm)

lybra_audit_verdict_confirm.description: Confirm an audit verdict dry-run (AIPOS-328: auditor self-confirm via owner_confirmation_token).

autonomy_mode.description: Supervised (AIPOS-F22B) | PreAuthorized(AIPOS-F78B 件③: 驱动方 token + owner_autonomy_policy 信封一阶段落记录, 不索 owner_confirm)

lybra_roles_register.description: AIPOS-352F1/F78B 件④a: register a custom role (name → builtin class) in the gate registry. Owner-gated via owner_authorization_ref. 单一实现(CLI `lybra roles register` 为其薄壳; 未挂入 TOOL_HANDLERS 的 dry_run/confirm 对已删)。落盘根按 workspace_root(token projects scope 校验)。

builtin_class.description: Built-in role class to map to

workspace_root.description: Workspace root(治理根); 缺省 = token 默认项目

lybra_my_tasks.description: AIPOS-F86/F87/F90/F93/F95 工位开工面 `lybra my-tasks --workstation <工位目录> --json`: 产品解析工位身份(charter_render.workstation_identity)、给出本实例 claimed 卡的开工面字段与选卡结论 next_card(判据 next_resolver.NEXT_CARD_RULE)。AIPOS-F95 件①: next_card.kickoff = 完整开工提示文本, 由产品按本条目 kickoff 声明渲染(next_resolver.render_kickoff 唯一实现); 工位 /go(go.ts)只原样发送 next_card.kickoff(缺/空 = 拒开工), lybra loop 自动拉起 harness 时用同一字段(逐字节相同)。

placeholders.report_field_lines: next_card.report_required_frontmatter 逐项按 report_field_line 成行(声明 transitions artifact_ingest 单源; 审计卡附被审 tip/tree 实值), 以换行连接
placeholders.remote_material: AIPOS-F110 件②: 本机工位 = 空串(开工提示与 F110 前逐字节相同); 跨机工位 = 按 remote_material 模板渲染的门机材料段(`my-tasks --remote-workstation` 经 next_resolver.remote_kickoff_context 取上下文交 render_kickoff; lybra loop 拉起跨机工位时传该参数)

kickoff.remote_material: 以上工作树、报告落点、任务卡均在门机 {gate_host}(治理根 {governance_root}), 不在你的工位 {workstation_host} 本地; 门机在你的工位上的 ssh 别名: {gate_ssh_alias}; 材料访问方式(项目声明): {material_access}
kickoff.remote_material_note: AIPOS-F110 件②: 占位 gate_host = 门机(驱动方)主机名, governance_root = 门机治理根, workstation_host = land 事件 host, gate_ssh_alias / material_access = project.json workstations.<实例> 声明(远端视角)。占位缺值 = 渲染失败(fail-closed); 声明值含凭据字样在读声明时即拒。
kickoff.note: 与 F95 前 go.ts 字面量文案等义(开工提示只含工作树/报告落点/卡路径/报告必填字段, 零门动词)。任一占位缺值或报告必填字段形变 = 渲染失败, 该卡不入选 next_card(拒因 KICKOFF_UNRESOLVED, fail-closed)。

lybra_loop.description: AIPOS-F73D 顾问侧驱动器 `lybra loop`: Owner 信封授权下, 有界循环推进一张卡到 completed。每轮 = `next` 推导 → 账务命令经 `next --run` 同一执行体(next_resolver.execute_derived_action)执行并重推导; agent 步(spawn_worker/await_artifact)只调既有 `agent watch --expect` 有界等待产物; 唯一例外 = AIPOS-F95: Owner 信封 launch_harnesses 授权该卡 harness 且条件全满足时, 进入等待前按 enums.schema harness.launch 模板在工位拉起一次 harness 进程(见本条目 launch), 否则退回手工模式(工位敲 /go, 行为同 F95 前); closure 记录存在且治理已落账(transitions nodes.N6.landing 判据)即 exit 0, 结案后未落账先执行 N6 落账步(lybra governance-commit --task-id, AIPOS-F94)。本条目是 loop 退出码/参数/信封动词集合的唯一声明; 代码(tools/aipos_cli/loop_driver.py)只读不写死。
lybra_loop.step_timeout_note: AIPOS-F90 件①(缺陷③): loop/next --run 执行派生命令子进程的硬上限(next_resolver.loop_step_timeout_seconds 唯一读取口, 原写死 120s); 不变量: ≥ 门 initialize(config.schema timeouts.gate_mcp_request_ms) + 两阶段最大 client_timeout_ms×2 + 超时回读一次, 夹具核。

single_implementation.derivation_core: tools/aipos_cli/next_resolver.derive_next_step (AIPOS-F71 唯一推导核, 禁第二推导核)
single_implementation.waiter: tools/aipos_cli/agent_watch_fs.run_fs_watch (AIPOS-268/284 唯一哨兵, expect_ready 谓词 = 推导核可推导)
single_implementation.envelope: tools/aipos_cli/autonomy_policy (owner_autonomy_policy 族, 5_tasks/policies/*.md, match_claim_envelope 严格 AND)
single_implementation.parser_gate: 每条派生命令执行前经 aipos_cli.build_parser().parse_args 解析, 解析失败=exit 4 禁执行 (AIPOS-F73D 前置一③)

envelope.description: policy_id (5_tasks/policies/<id>.md); 缺省=扫描 policies/ 取首个匹配本卡与驱动方身份的有效信封

actor.description: 驱动方身份(顾问实例); 缺省=治理根 .lybra/role 的 instance, 再缺省=advisor

connection_json.description: 透传给 next --run 的 connection.json 路径(token 永不上屏)

workspace_root.description: 治理根(队列/记录所在); 缺省=自发现

max_steps.description: 硬上限: 推导轮数(含等待轮), 超限 exit 3

max_wait.description: 硬上限: 每次等待产物的秒数(沿用 agent watch --timeout 默认 1800)

interval.description: 等待轮询间隔秒(沿用 agent watch --interval 默认 15); 等待一律经 watch, 禁 sleep 自旋

no_launch.description: AIPOS-F95 件③: 不拉起 harness 进程(即使信封 launch_harnesses 授权), 退回手工模式: 等待提示「请在 <工位目录> 的 <harness> 会话敲 /go」

verbose.description: AIPOS-F142 件②: 另输出门侧信封判定诊断行([ENVELOPE_TRACE], stderr); 缺省不打印(开关声明 envelope_trace)

completed.meaning: 走到 completed: closure 记录存在且治理已落账(transitions nodes.N6.landing.criterion: 本卡落账范围已提交且已推送)

gate_rejected.meaning: 门拒(或 N6 落账被拒: 他人暂存 / 提交门护栏 / 推送未完成): 透传拒因原文+出口, 不重试

wait_timeout.meaning: 等待产物超时/停滞(输出等的是哪份产物), 或 --max-steps 用尽

not_derivable.meaning: 推导不可推导(输出 missing_records; 含治理根不在 git 仓 = N6 落账 fail-closed, 附 nodes.N6.landing.non_git_exit 出口), 或派生命令解析失败/需人工介入, 或落账步报成功但判据仍未落账

no_envelope.meaning: 无有效 autonomy 信封(输出 `lybra envelope mint` 申领出口), 或信封未授权该动词

envelope.family: owner_autonomy_policy (5_tasks/policies/<policy_id>.md, 由 `lybra envelope mint` 申领, owner_decision_record 落 grant)
envelope.matcher: autonomy_policy.match_claim_envelope(策略有效+时间窗+agent_or_role 覆盖驱动方身份或 advisor 角色+task_selector 覆盖本卡+count_bound)
envelope.subject_rule: AIPOS-F90 件①: 信封 task_selector(task_mode/project/task_ids)的判定对象——审计卡(task_mode=audit 且声明 reviewed_task_id)= 被审卡, 其余 = 本卡; 驱动方(loop_driver.find_envelope)与门(_match_claim_envelope)同读唯一实现 autonomy_policy.envelope_subject。审计卡认领同样计入信封额度(count_bound)。
envelope.allowed_verbs_note: loop 只执行 action_type 在此集合内的派生命令; 集合外(含 manual)=exit 5/4。集合唯一声明在此。AIPOS-F78B 件③: 门侧驱动方一阶段放行(queue return/audit-verdict/queue close 的 autonomy_mode=PreAuthorized)也读此集合判 verb 是否在信封授权内(claim 经 _match_claim_envelope, 其余经 _match_driver_envelope, 同一 matcher autonomy_policy.match_claim_envelope)。 AIPOS-F94: governance_commit = N6 落账步(transitions nodes.N6.landing), 独立列入本集合(非门动词, 门侧 _match_driver_envelope 不会收到它); 覆盖驱动方与本卡的有效信封即授权落账。 AIPOS-F123: 收编(lybra_queue_adopt_dry_run, verb_family=claim)按 claim 判授权——门侧经 _match_driver_envelope(verb=声明的 verb_family), 不另列动词。
envelope.one_stage_release: 驱动方 token(roles.schema driver.role_class 或其 role_class 自定义角色) + autonomy_mode=PreAuthorized + owner_policy_ref 命名的信封(agent_or_role 覆盖驱动方实例/角色类, task_selector 覆盖本卡, 有效/时间窗/额度) → 门在 dry_run 一跳内落记录(preauthorized_release=true), 不索 owner_confirm; 不匹配 = BLOCK + envelope_guards 出口, CLI 薄壳 exit 5(无信封)。
envelope.launch_harnesses: AIPOS-F95 件②(b): 信封字段 launch_harnesses(harness 值列表, 取值 ⊆ enums.schema harness 中 launch 非 null 者; 缺省 [] = 不授权拉起, 只手工 /go)。`lybra envelope mint --launch-harness <harness>`(可重复)经 --confirm 由 Owner 签, 门 owner_decision_record 同一路径落盘。loop 判授权 = autonomy_policy.envelope_authorizes_launch(同一信封族唯一实现, 禁第二实现)。
envelope.boundary_template: This artifact records a bounded, revocable Owner pre-authorization (PreAuthorized envelope). Within its time bound, count bound and task_selector it authorizes the covered driver (`lybra loop`, one-stage gate release) to run only these verbs: {allowed_verbs} (declared in verbs.schema lybra_loop.envelope.allowed_verbs). Harness launch authorized: {launch_harnesses} (the loop may start a declared enums.schema harness.launch template once per card at the enrolled local workstation; otherwise the workstation starts work by hand with /go). It does not authorize publish, credential access, or any verb outside this list. Reaching the time or count bound, or status revoked/expired, drops matching actions back to Supervised (per-task owner_confirm).
envelope.boundary_template_note: AIPOS-F95 件②(c): 信封正文 Boundary 由本模板渲染(autonomy_policy.build_autonomy_policy_markdown 唯一渲染), {allowed_verbs} = 本条目 allowed_verbs 实值, {launch_harnesses} = 信封 launch_harnesses 实值(空 = none (manual /go only))。存量信封正文不改写(追加式), 新铸即正确。
envelope.task_selector_lane_repo: AIPOS-F134 件③: 信封字段 task_selector_lane_repo(缺省 ""/键缺 = 不限 lane, 存量信封行为不变)——值 = 本项目 project.json repos.items 的仓名(无清单时 = code_repo 路径), `lybra envelope mint --lane-repo <仓名>` 经 --confirm 由 Owner 签, 门 owner_decision_writer._normalize_autonomy_policy 按 workspace_config.resolve_card_repo 校验可解析(不可解析 = BLOCK)。判定对象 = subject_rule 所指卡的 lane.repo 经 resolve_card_repo 解析出的仓(autonomy_policy.card_lane_refs: 路径 / 卡面原值 / 指向同一路径的仓名), 判定只在 match_claim_envelope 谓词 lane_repo 与原因链(不匹配 = transitions envelope_guards.selector_lane_repo_mismatch)。用途: 同一项目多顾问实例各管一个 lane(如 OTA 顾问只推 OTA 仓的卡)。AIPOS-F139: 值为仓集合——`--lane-repo` 可重复(一个子项目跨多个仓; 共用仓可同时列入多个顾问的信封), 新铸信封 frontmatter 落列表, 存量单值信封按单元素集合读(文件逐字节不变); 集合内每个名都须可解析, 任一不可解析 = BLOCK(逐个点名); 卡 lane 指称命中集合任一即匹配, 不匹配原因链列出整个集合。集合序列化/解析唯一 workspace_config.repo_name_set(见 lane_view.repo_set)。

launch.description: AIPOS-F95 件③: loop 内拉起薄函数(tools/aipos_cli/loop_driver.py, 无守护/调度/心跳/常驻): 在 N1 执行体等待与 N3 审计体等待进入 watch 之前, 条件全满足才拉起一次——①信封 launch_harnesses 覆盖该卡 harness(卡面值, 缺省 card.schema default_by_task_mode); ②该 harness 有 launch 模板(enums.schema harness.launch 非 null)且其可执行在驱动方 PATH; ③按本项目 enrollment_log 中该实例最新 land 事件定位工位位置 {host, dir}, transport(enums.schema workstation_transport)已支持(local; AIPOS-F110 起 remote 经 ssh, 见本段 remote); ④charter_render.workstation_identity(dir) 的实例 = 卡 assigned_to(审计卡 = 其认领实例)(remote 工位: 门机读不到远端目录, 身份 = land 事件实例, 另须 project.json workstations.<实例> 材料声明 + ssh 探测可达); ⑤未给 --no-launch; ⑥kickoff = 该工位 `my-tasks --workstation <dir> --task-id <等待目标卡> --json` 的 next_card.kickoff(AIPOS-F111 件①: 按卡号取, 只核验等待目标卡这一张——判据 next_resolver.kickoff_refusal, 与工位 `/go <卡号>` 同一判据; 不要求该卡是工位 NEXT_CARD_RULE 选卡结果, 同一工位同时在办多张卡可各自拉起; 唯一实现 loop_driver.workstation_kickoff)(remote: `my-tasks --actor <实例> --task-id <卡> --remote-workstation`, 同一 render_kickoff 附门机材料段)。任一不满足 → 退回手工模式(等待提示含工位目录与 /go; remote 工位提示 <host>:<dir>)。
launch.grace_note: 产物就绪后给进程的宽限期(秒): 期内自行退出即收尾, 超期终止整个进程组
launch.terminate_note: 终止进程组: 先 SIGTERM, 等本秒数仍未退出再 SIGKILL
launch.stderr_tail_note: 进程退出而产物未就绪(早退) → exit 3(wait_timeout), 附 stderr 末尾本行数

manual_hint.local: 请在 {dir} 的 {harness} 会话敲 /go
manual_hint.remote: 请在 {host}:{dir} 的 {harness} 会话敲 /go(跨机工位)
manual_hint.unlocated: 请在实例 {instance} 的工位({harness} 会话)敲 /go(工位位置定位不到: {reason})
manual_hint.note: 手工模式(未拉起)的等待提示唯一声明; 占位 {dir}/{host}/{harness}/{instance}/{reason} 由 loop 按工位位置(enrollment_log land 事件)填入

launch.progress_note: stdout 事件流(enums.schema harness.launch.events)逐行汇总为一行式进度(工具调用名+首段参数 / 助手文本首行 / 错误), 每行截断到本字符数; 未知事件类型只计数不刷屏, 结束时一行计数; 凭据字样(token/secret/password/api key/credential/bearer)所在行整行隐去, 长凭据串打码
lifecycle: 新进程组(start_new_session)、无 shell、stdin=/dev/null、cwd=工位目录、环境继承驱动方
等待仍经唯一哨兵 agent_watch_fs.run_fs_watch(expect_ready = 推导核可推导); 进程退出也唤醒(stop_when)
产物就绪 → 宽限 grace_seconds 后终止进程组
进程退出而产物未就绪 → exit 3 附 stderr 末尾 stderr_tail_lines 行
等待超时 → 终止进程组后 exit 3
loop 收到 SIGINT/SIGTERM → 先终止进程组, 再按该信号退出(不新增退出码)
一次 loop 运行对一张卡至多拉起一次, 不自动重试(重跑 loop = 显式再拉起)
拉起与收尾事件追加进该卡既有 session record 的 Events(谁拉起/何时/harness/工位/pid), 不新建记录类型
AIPOS-F110 跨机(transport=remote): 本地只起 ssh 子进程(新进程组、无 shell、cwd 不设、stdin=管道写入 kickoff 后关闭); 远端按 remote 段声明起新进程组并回传组号; 终止 = 经 ssh 对远端组 TERM→等 terminate_wait_seconds→KILL, 再清本地 ssh 组

remote.description: AIPOS-F110 件①: transport=remote(enums.schema workstation_transport)的拉起声明。ssh 目标 = 该实例最新 land 事件 host(enroll_deliver --ssh 写入的 ssh 目标), 不另设声明位。拉起 argv = ssh_argv + [<host>, <远端命令>]; 远端命令 = 固定 sh 脚本 + 逐个 shell 引号化的参数(工位目录 + harness.launch.argv 模板原样, 含 {kickoff} 占位)——kickoff 不进命令行, 经 ssh stdin 逐字节传入, 远端脚本按字节读尽 stdin 后整参数替换 {kickoff}(kickoff 原文中的 ` $( ${ 换行等 shell 元字符不经任何 shell 展开); 远端 set -m 作业 = 新进程组, 组号以 pgid_marker 行首行回传(stdout 其余行照常按 events 汇总)。实现唯一: tools/aipos_cli/harness_launch.py(remote_launch_command / probe_remote / LaunchedHarness / terminate_group)。
remote.ssh_argv_note: -T 不分配终端; BatchMode=yes 不交互索要口令(凭据只走 ssh 自身配置/密钥, 永不经 Lybra); 探测/拉起/清理共用本前缀(可注入的 ssh 执行器 = PATH 上的 ssh, 夹具以替身走同一代码路径)
remote.remote_shell_note: 远端脚本解释器: 须支持非交互 set -m 作业控制(后台作业 = 新进程组); dash 无终端时关作业控制故不用 sh。macOS / 常见 Linux 均自带 bash; 远端无此解释器 = 探测拒(exit 127)
remote.pgid_note: 拉起后至多等本秒数收远端组号行; 未收到(ssh 断开/远端脚本失败/超时)= 拉起失败(清本地 ssh 组, exit 3 附 stderr 末尾与手工提示)
remote.probe_note: 拉起前探测: ssh 可达 + 远端工位目录存在 + harness 可执行在远端非交互 PATH(exit 255 = ssh 不可达; 3 = 目录不存在; 4 = 可执行不在 PATH)。任一不过 = 不拉起, 退回手工并提示原因
remote.kill_note: 清理时每次经 ssh 发信号的超时; 远端发信号失败(ssh 不可达/超时)不吞: 记入收尾事件 termination=remote_kill_failed(...), 本地 ssh 组照清
remote.material_declaration: project.json workstations.<实例>(config.schema configuration_sources.project_json.schema.workstations): gate_ssh_alias(远端视角门机 ssh 别名)+ material_access(远端经何种方式读写门机材料)。remote 工位未声明 = 拒拉起, 提示 `lybra project set-workstation`; 含凭据字样 = 拒(提示里永不出现凭据)

run_record.description: AIPOS-F131 件①③: 每次 `lybra loop` 在项目声明的落点(project.json paths.loop_runs_root, 唯一读取口 workspace_config.project_paths; 缺省 5_tasks/records/loop_runs)维护本次运行的一份运行记录 <loop_runs_root>/<卡ID>/looprun_<卡ID>_<compact 时间>_<loop pid>.md(frontmatter 带 record_type, 过入库护栏 B④; 原子替换写)与同名 .log 日志(首块 frontmatter 带 log_record_type, 其后只追加)。记录内容: run_id、驱动方、信封、主机、loop pid 与进程启动时刻指纹(AIPOS-F137)、开始/更新时间; 每步(轮号/节点/状态/卡/动作/结果/退出码/时间, 不记命令与输出原文)与当前步(含等待对象与起始时间); 每次拉起(harness/transport/host/工位/pid/pgid/remote_pgid/进程启动时刻指纹/开始与收尾时间/outcome/returncode/termination)及其活动(事件条数、最近一行输出时间、最近有意义活动的时间与类别、按类计数); 结束时间/outcome/exit_code(读本条目 exit_codes)/end_reason/end_message(首行, 经 redact_progress)。**不落会话正文、工具参数、kickoff 与命令行原文**(探活只落进程启动时刻指纹 loop_run_record.process_fingerprint: Linux starttime / 无 /proc 用 ps lstart, 同一进程改标题 / 改名 / exec 不变, pid 复用的新进程必不同; F137 前写的命令行 sha1 旧指纹降级为仅按 pid 判并标注)。日志 = loop 人读输出逐行(经 harness_launch.redact_progress), 拉起进程的进度行在日志里只写类别(stdout 照旧一行式进度, 行为不变)。唯一实现 tools/aipos_cli/loop_run_record.py(LoopRunRecorder 写 / judge_run 判 / loop_status 读)。运行记录是运行期观测, 不属卡落账范围(governance_commit.card_own_paths 跳过 loop_runs_root: loop 在落账后仍写结束原因, 若入范围则落账判据永不过); 需入库时照常经 governance-commit。记录建不起来 = loop 拒跑 exit 4(not_derivable, fail-closed: 运行须可查); 中途写失败不打断推进, 每种原因出声一次并计 write_errors。
run_record.activity_flush_note: 拉起进程活动写入节流: 每拉起首条活动立即写, 之后每本秒数至多写一次(等待期 sleeper 每轮调 flush, 静默期也把最后一条落盘); 步骤开始/落定、拉起开始/收尾、结束一律立即写
run_record.stall_note: 停滞判据(lybra loop status 唯一判据 loop_run_record.judge_run): loop 进程在、拉起进程在(pid 存在且进程启动时刻指纹一致, AIPOS-F137), 而距该进程最近一行输出(无输出则距拉起时刻)超过阈值 = stalled。阈值: 最近有意义活动是工具开始(tool:<名>, 工具在跑、跑全量测试等长命令期间本就无输出)= stall_after_tool_seconds, 否则 stall_after_seconds。只作显示判定, 不杀进程(进程去留仍按 launch 生命周期); 调用方禁各自 grep 日志判停滞

activity_categories.tool:<工具名>: pi-json tool_execution_start(只记工具名, 不记参数)
activity_categories.tool_error:<工具名>: pi-json tool_execution_end 且 isError(不记结果正文)
activity_categories.tool_end:<工具名>: pi-json tool_execution_end 正常结束(不记结果正文)
activity_categories.assistant: pi-json message_end 助手发言(不记正文)
activity_categories.output: 非 pi-json 事件流的一行 stdout / pi-json 流里的非 JSON 行
activity_categories.stream: 背景事件(流式增量/回合边界/非助手消息/未知类型): 只刷新最近输出时间, 不改最近活动类别

states.running: 运行中: loop 进程在; 若有在途拉起, 其进程在且未超停滞阈值
states.stalled: 停滞: loop 与拉起进程都在, 但拉起进程超过 stall_after_seconds 无输出
states.launch_dead: 拉起进程已不在(被杀/崩溃/已退出未收尾)而 loop 仍在等
states.loop_dead: loop 进程已不在而记录未写结束(被 SIGKILL/主机重启等): 记录停在最后一次写入
states.unprobeable: 记录写于别的主机, 本机无从探活: 在治理根所在机(经 ssh 亦可)执行 lybra loop status

end_reasons.wait_timeout: 手工模式等待产物超时(exit_codes.wait_timeout)
end_reasons.launch_timeout: 拉起后等待产物超时, 已终止进程组(exit_codes.wait_timeout)
end_reasons.launch_early_exit: 拉起的进程退出而产物未就绪(exit_codes.wait_timeout)
end_reasons.launch_record_failed: 拉起事件写不进 session record(exit_codes.not_derivable)
end_reasons.frontmatter_unreadable: 卡或记录 frontmatter 读不出(exit_codes.not_derivable)
end_reasons.manual_required: 需人工介入/无法识别动词(exit_codes.not_derivable)
end_reasons.landing_unverified: 落账步报成功但判据仍未落账(exit_codes.not_derivable)
end_reasons.interrupted: loop 收到 SIGINT/SIGTERM/SIGHUP(已清拉起进程组; exit_code 记 128+信号)
end_reasons.crashed: loop 内部异常退出(exit_code 记 1; 异常类型进 end_message)

executor.meaning: 执行体产物 <paths.return_root>/{task_id}/<候选> (骨架不算, 判据=推导核; 等待经 next_resolver.executor_artifact_watch)

auditor.meaning: 审计体产物 <paths.verdict_root>/{audit_task_id}/<候选> 完成判据见 artifact_ingest.verdict.readiness (等待经 next_resolver.auditor_artifact_watch)

invariants: 默认不唤醒 agent: agent 步只等产物, 开会话由 Owner/工位无参命令 /go; 唯一例外 = Owner 信封 launch_harnesses 授权下按声明模板拉起一次(AIPOS-F95, 见 launch), 门仍被动, 认领仍由驱动方经门完成, 进程存活不作真相
禁静默/禁无限循环: --max-steps 与 --max-wait 为硬上限, 任一出口非零带原文
禁 sleep 自旋: 等待一律经 agent watch
禁直调 board_adapter/queue_mutation 做门动作

lybra_loop_status.description: AIPOS-F131 件②: `lybra loop status [--task-id <ID>] [--workspace-root <治理根>] [--json]` —— 读 loop 运行记录(lybra_loop.run_record)+ 本机探活(pid 存在且进程启动时刻指纹一致, AIPOS-F137)+ 判停滞, 输出: 运行中/已结束、当前步与等待对象、拉起进程存活与否/已运行时长/距最近输出多久/最近活动类别与时间、停滞判定(states)、结束原因, 以及记录与日志路径。--task-id 给出 = 该卡最近一次运行(含已结束); 缺省 = 本项目全部未结束的运行。只读, 不写任何文件、不起任何进程、不发信号; 输出不含凭据与会话正文(记录本身不落)。跨机: 在治理根所在机执行(经 ssh 亦可); 记录主机 ≠ 本机 = unprobeable。判据唯一实现 tools/aipos_cli/loop_run_record.judge_run, 禁调用方 tail/grep 原始日志自判。AIPOS-F136 件①: 输出增「顾问下一动作」(next_action 段, 唯一判定 loop_run_record.next_action); `--wait <秒>` 有界等待到可行动或到时(wait 段), 退出码按下一动作。

task_id.description: 卡 ID; 缺省 = 列本项目全部未结束的 loop 运行

workspace_root.description: 治理根; 缺省自发现

lane.description: AIPOS-F133 件② / F139: 只看该 lane(或仓集合: --lane 可重复)的运行(声明 lane_view; 运行记录反查卡面取 lane)

include_frozen.description: AIPOS-F141 件①: 也列出存量冻结卡的运行(标 frozen); 缺省不列(lane_view.visible_cards)。给 --task-id = 显式点名, 照列

wait.description: AIPOS-F136 件①: 有界等待秒数(须 --task-id; 0 < 秒数 ≤ wait.max_seconds)。经 agent watch 唯一等待原语 run_fs_watch(expect = 本卡运行记录, expect_ready = 顾问下一动作 ≠ continue_wait)等到可行动或到时, 返回当时状态; 退出码按下一动作(exit_codes)

verbose.description: AIPOS-F138 件③: 输出门侧信封判定诊断行([ENVELOPE_TRACE], autonomy_policy.trace_envelope 逐谓词留痕, 走 stderr); 缺省不打印(状态结论不被淹没)。只开关输出, 信封判定逻辑不变。AIPOS-F142 件②: 开关统一由 envelope_trace 声明承载

wait.note: AIPOS-F136 件①: --wait 上限与轮询间隔(唯一声明)。等待经 tools/aipos_cli/agent_watch_fs.run_fs_watch(loop 的唯一等待原语, 禁 sleep 自旋): 观察根 = 项目声明的运行记录落点 project.json paths.loop_runs_root(唯一读取口 workspace_config.project_paths), expect = <卡ID>/looprun_*.md, 每轮由 judge_run + next_action 重判(进程死 / 停滞 / 结束无需文件变化也在下一轮被判出)。到时 = 返回当时状态(continue_wait)。顾问取本会话单次命令超时以内的秒数; 超上限 = 用法错(usage), 不截断。

next_action.description: AIPOS-F136 件①: 顾问下一动作(唯一判定 tools/aipos_cli/loop_run_record.next_action; 输出与 --json 每个运行附 next_action {action, reason, detail, hint}, --task-id 时顶层另附本卡的 next_action)。判据只读运行记录: 状态(judge_run)→ by_state; 已结束 → 结束原因 by_end_reason(结束原因原文 end_message 即门/推导核的拒因, 一并给出); 本卡最近连续 consecutive_failures_owner_needed 次运行都以 investigate 类原因结束 = 连败 → owner_needed。

actions.continue_wait: loop 仍在推进(或在等工位产物): 再跑一次 `lybra loop status --task-id <卡ID> --wait <秒>`; reason=manual_kickoff 时 loop 在手工模式等工位, 向 Owner 说一次 detail 里的开工提示(在哪个工位敲 /go), 然后继续等
actions.owner_needed: 须 Owner 决定/授权: 停下, 一次说清 detail 里要 Owner 定什么(设计分叉 / 授权 / 连败 / 门拒原因), Owner 定了再续跑 loop
actions.card_done_take_next: 本卡已结案并落账: 取本 lane 下一张(next_card 与 hint 由 F133「下一张」出口给出; 无可推进卡时 hint 为 lane 扫描)
actions.investigate: loop 或其拉起的进程异常(停滞 / 进程已不在 / 别机记录)或以推导/产物类原因结束: 按 hint 查(`lybra next --task-id <卡ID>` 给缺项与出口), 能修的出卡修、修好续跑 loop; 修不了 = 升 owner_needed

owner_reasons.gate_rejected: 门拒: 按拒因原文裁定(设计分叉 / 越界 / 冲突), 改卡或仲裁后续跑
owner_reasons.landing_rejected: N6 落账被拒(他人暂存 / 提交门护栏 / 推送未完成): 由 Owner 定怎么处理他人改动后续跑
owner_reasons.no_envelope: 授权: 无有效信封(缺 / 过期 / 额度用尽), 请 Owner 签发或续额
owner_reasons.verb_not_authorized: 授权: 信封未授权该动词, 请 Owner 决定是否扩授权
owner_reasons.manual_required: 需人工裁定: 推导核给不出可执行命令(见 detail 的建议动作)
owner_reasons.wait_timeout: 工位开工: 手工模式下工位未交产物, 请 Owner 在工位敲 /go(或签带 --launch-harness 的信封授权拉起), 之后续跑 loop
owner_reasons.consecutive_failures: 连败: 本卡最近连续多次运行都异常结束, 不再自动续跑, 请 Owner 定是否改卡 / 换执行体 / 仲裁

next_action.take_next_note: AIPOS-F136 × F133: card_done_take_next 接 F133「下一张」唯一出口(next_resolver.scan_project + pick_next_card, 判据 lane_view.next_card), 范围 = 本卡 lane(lane 不可解析 = 全项目); 有下一张 = take_next_hint(直接推进它), 无 = take_next_none_hint(按 lane 扫描看为何无可推进卡)

ok.meaning: 已输出(无 --wait; 缺 --task-id 时无未结束运行也为 0, 输出写明)

card_done_take_next.meaning: --wait: 下一动作 = card_done_take_next(本卡已结案并落账)

usage.meaning: --wait 用法错(缺 --task-id / 秒数 ≤ 0 / 超 wait.max_seconds), 零等待

continue_wait.meaning: --wait: 到时仍是 continue_wait(loop 仍在推进 / 等工位产物)

no_run.meaning: --task-id 指定的卡无 loop 运行记录(--wait 时 = 到时仍无)

unreadable.meaning: 运行记录读不出 / record_type 不符 / 治理根或声明解析失败(点名文件, 不跳过)

owner_needed.meaning: --wait: 下一动作 = owner_needed(须 Owner 决定 / 授权, 事由见输出)

investigate.meaning: --wait: 下一动作 = investigate(停滞 / 进程已不在 / 别机记录 / 推导或产物类结束原因)

lybra_charter.description: AIPOS-F138 件①: `lybra charter --role <角色类> [--instance <实例>] [--harness <kind>] [--workspace-root <治理根>]` —— 拉取式输出该实例的渲染后章程全文到 stdout(母本 + 项目声明 + 写权限边界, 与 sync 落盘同一渲染器 charter_render.render_charter, 同一上下文构造 charter_render_context)。供本机无落点的会话(他机 Codex 顾问)开局经 ssh 在治理根所在机读取(distribution.schema harness_semantics.remote_session_delivery); Lybra 不推送。实例 = 本治理根 enrollment_log 中有 land 事件(enrollment.workstation_location)且其工位 .lybra/role 实例相符者; 缺 --instance = 治理根 .lybra/role 的实例。harness 缺省 = 该工位 role 记录的 harness。输出只含声明文本: 不含凭据 / 令牌 / 注册码(身份只经 workstation_identity 读非秘密字段)。只读: 不写任何文件、不连门、不起进程。
lybra_charter.single_implementation: tools/aipos_cli/charter_render.instance_charter(渲染) / charter_pull_command(拉取出口拼装) / run_charter_cli(CLI 薄壳; argparse 参数由本条 parameters 生成)

role.description: 角色类(roles.schema 内建类, 如 advisor); 须等于该实例 .lybra/role 角色解析出的类(custom_roles.resolve_role_to_class), 不符 = 拒

instance.description: 实例名(注册表模板); 缺省 = 治理根 .lybra/role 的实例(顾问工位即治理根)

harness.description: 取哪个 harness 的章程条目(distribution.schema harness_semantics.kinds 的键); 缺省 = 该工位 role 记录的 harness

workspace_root.description: 治理根; 缺省 = 当前目录向上首个已建治理根(workspace_config.enclosing_governance_root, 不读活动项目)

ok.meaning: 章程全文已输出到 stdout

usage.meaning: 参数错(缺 --role / harness 不在声明内), 零输出

lybra_governance_commit.description: AIPOS-R7A2/F69/F79: governance-repo commit — the ONLY commit path for the truth layer (advisor-side). F79: explicit --paths whitelist (git add -- <paths>, never add -A when given; paths outside the governance root or pointing at another project are rejected fail-closed); --dry-run lists the exact files that would be committed without touching the scene (read-only git status --porcelain / git diff --name-status; no add/reset/stash); after a real commit, git show --name-only HEAD is verified against that manifest. Whole-root mode (no --paths) is reserved for lybra's own workspace; every other project MUST pass --paths. Pre-staged files: inside --paths = accepted into the manifest, outside --paths = rejected and listed. AIPOS-R6M file-level guardrails (pre-commit hook) still apply to the selected files. CLI-only (surface=cli); push reuses the F69 fetch -> rebase -> push -> remote-verify flow.

actor.description: Actor performing the governance commit (advisor instance)

task_id.description: Task ID for N6 closure (optional; omit for governance batch updates). AIPOS-F94: without paths/paths_file = task-scoped precise commit — whitelist derived from the card and declarations (transitions nodes.N6.landing.scope), never whole-root; empty scope = BLOCK; already committed and pushed (nodes.N6.landing.criterion) = PASS no-op

workspace_root.description: Product repo root for schema resolution (defaults to ~/projects/lybra)

paths.description: AIPOS-F79: whitelist of paths relative to the governance root (file or directory; CLI: repeat --paths). When given, ONLY these are staged via git add -- <paths>; add -A is never used. Any path outside the governance root (including other projects, absolute paths, .. escapes, symlinks resolving outside) rejects the whole call. Mandatory for every project other than lybra's own workspace.

paths_file.description: AIPOS-F79: file with one whitelist path per line (blank and # lines ignored). Same implementation as paths; mutually exclusive with paths.

dry_run.description: AIPOS-F79: validate and emit commit_manifest (files grouped as modified/added/deleted/untracked_selected) WITHOUT touching the scene: no git add/reset/stash. Without paths, lists everything git add -A -- . would swallow and warns with the untracked count.

no_push.description: Commit but do not push (default: push via F69 flow)

json.description: Emit the result object as JSON (includes selected_paths, commit_manifest, rejected_paths / pre_staged_outside when applicable)

exit_codes.0: PASS — committed (and pushed unless no_push), or no-op (nothing to commit within the selection), or dry_run manifest emitted
exit_codes.1: BLOCK/FAIL — e.g. paths outside governance root (rejected_paths), pre-staged files outside --paths (pre_staged_outside), N6 completeness missing, staged set != manifest, pre-commit guardrail (AIPOS-R6M) rejection, post-commit git show != manifest, push/verification failure
exit_codes.2: usage error — argparse rejected the arguments (unknown flag / missing --actor)
